name: Duty or tax or fee rate basis code
description: Code specifying the basis for a duty or tax or fee rate.

values.name: Value
values.description: Value (5316) To specify that the applicable rate of duty, tax or fee is based on the Customs value (CCC).

values.name: Weight
values.description: Weight To specify that the applicable rate of duty, tax or fee is based on the weight of the item (CCC).

values.name: Quantity
values.description: Quantity (6060) To specify that the applicable rate of duty, tax or fee is based on the quantity of the item (CCC).
